objects.name: Analytic 2262
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a password change event for an Industrial Control System (ICS) service or operator account performed by an account not in the authorized credential administration role, immediately followed by failed authentication attempts from the Industrial Control System (ICS) service itself. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
